Hope you’re doing well! I was thinking it would be fun to go out this Friday night—maybe grab dinner or catch a movie. Let me know if you’re free and what you’d like to do.

Looking forward to hearing from you!

Best,  
[Your Name]

---

Feel free to tweak the wording or add any details (like a specific venue or time) that suit your plans. If you’d like me to personalize it further or need help sending it, just let me know!
